STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give two different QD hard-filter thresholds for SNPs:
- Vendor default (active): an SNP is filtered when QD < 2.0 [alt_CF-QD] [G:Threshold:QD_lt_2]
- Local SOP / clinic protocol (alternative, not the vendor default): an SNP is filtered when QD < 1.5 [fx_sop_qd] [alt_CF-QD]
The context does not choose between these values.

STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give two different FS hard-filter thresholds for SNPs:
- Vendor default (active): an SNP is filtered when FS > 60.0 [alt_CF-FS] [G:Threshold:FS_gt_60_snp]
- Local SOP / clinic protocol (alternative, not the vendor default): an SNP is filtered when FS > 45.0 [fx_clinic_fs] [alt_CF-FS]
The context does not choose between these values.

STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give two different SOR thresholds for the hard-filtering procedure HF-01 [G:Procedure:HF-01]:
- Vendor default (active): variants are filtered when SOR > 3.0 [alt_CF-SOR] [G:Threshold:SOR_gt_3]
- Local SOP / clinic protocol (alternative, not the vendor default): variants are filtered when SOR > 4.0 [fx_sop_sor] [alt_CF-SOR]
The context does not choose between these values.

STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give two different Java versions for running or building GATK:
- Current GATK 4.x README (active): Java 17 is needed to run or build GATK [gatk_readme#h001]
- GATK v4.2 legacy build notes (superseded, valid 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-26): a Java 8 JDK is required [fx_gatk_java] [alt_CF-JAVA]
The context does not choose between these versions.
